items.why: The report states "The 352/357 cm⁻¹ band is a blend of 2LA(M) and E′(Γ)" and fits it with a "Two-Lorentzian fit" giving components at "~350–352 cm⁻¹" and "356–358 cm⁻¹", which matches the two-component requirement.
No 2LA(M)/A1g ratio above 2 and no spot-to-spot contrast is given; the report gives only a combined band/A1g area of "~0.3 to ~0.8" across excitation energies.
The report gives one A1g position, "418.3 ± 1 cm⁻¹ at every energy", and never compares ~417.2 cm⁻¹ at spot 1 with ~420.1 cm⁻¹ at spot 2.
No separation value is given; the report says "A E′ to A1g splitting cannot be measured because E′ is blended with 2LA(M)", even though it fitted the two components.
The report says "thin few-layer cannot be excluded" but never mentions the ~1 cm⁻¹ steps between 2L, 3L and bulk, or that positions only weakly constrain layer number beyond 1L.
The report checks the Si line ("Si line is at 520.7–522.3 cm⁻¹ ... there may be an offset of ~1 cm⁻¹"), tracks A1g/Si ratios, and discusses resonance with excitation energy at length.

wrong_claims.why: The report explicitly says the band is a 2LA(M)+E′ blend and declines to use a separation from it for layer counting.
The band is assigned as 2LA(M), a second-order phonon, not a defect peak; the report notes "no direct defect-activated Raman marker".
